sections.section_name: Section C (Long Answer & Case Study Questions)

questions.question_text: Detail the role of producers, consumers, and decomposers in maintaining ecological balance.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: 1. Producers (Autotrophs): Capture solar energy to synthesize organic food via photosynthesis, forming the base of all food chains. 2. Consumers (Heterotrophs): Transfer energy across trophic levels (herbivores eat plants; carnivores eat herbivores), controlling population densities. 3. Decomposers (Saprotrophs): Break down complex organic waste into simple inorganic nutrients, returning minerals to soil for plant reabsorption.
